package main

import (
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
)

//go:noinline
func single(a chan int) {
	reflect.Select([]reflect.SelectCase{{Dir: reflect.SelectRecv, Chan: reflect.ValueOf(a)}})
}

func main() {
	a := make(chan int, 1)
	a <- 1
	single(a)
	done := make(chan struct{}, 2)
	go func() { done <- struct{}{} }()
	go func() { done <- struct{}{} }()
	runtime.Gosched()
	<-done
	<-done
}
